assumptions: Hypothetical projection: it assumes the stated reduction is achieved over the whole baseline period. It is not measured savings and does not show that any reduction happened.
estimated_savings = baseline x reduction_percentage / 100; projected_consumption = baseline - estimated_savings.
All consumption values are in kWh. The baseline period is 30 days and is never rescaled.
Baseline = sum of the electricity readings (kWh) in the 30 calendar days (UTC) ending on the most recent reading (2026-06-30), not on today's date.
Each record's consumption_value is consumption for its own interval (not a cumulative meter value); gaps are not filled or extrapolated.
warnings: Readings exist for 25 of the 30 days in the baseline window (83%). The baseline is the sum of the available readings (no gap filling), so it understates a complete period and the projected savings are understated by the same share.
No electricity emission factor configured; CO2e reduction not calculated.
